currentParagraphText: “Enjoy yourself,” Artemis said as she watched Jake walk out of the living room and toward the gateway.

finalResult.previousParagraphText: “I may just take you up on that casual chatting offer,” Jake smirked as he stood up and stretched. “In that case, I’m off. Going to be good to get in a few more levels.”
